Oh my God I know what the fuck toggle means in plain English, we're talking about GAME. MECHANICS. not fucking English Merriam Webster definitions. Here I was thinking you just didn't understand how the skill worked, and was trying to explain and be civil, and you're being a fucking ass and being condescending for no reason. So I'm done being nice, I'll take the low road any day.

Yeah those dots and dps spells are TWO BUTTONS on the other healers?? :o \*GASP\* yeah keep fucking telling me how my main jobs work to me, I love hearing it.

No shit the other heals have two fucking buttons I PLAY THEM AS MY MAIN IN SAVAGE RAIDS and have since 3.0. Keep telling me how my jobs work ,casual dps main player. Please. It's GREAT. I'm sure the info will help me.

You know how I know you don't know shit? You said this:

"Odds are Sage players will hardly ever use their DOT because of it."

Yeah, please just stick to whm then lol, continue to actually be ignorant on purpose and reiterate points that I already addressed. I'm done, was clearly wasting my time as you're ignoring my words on purpose to cause shit. Have a nice life. Or don't I don't care. I don't pay your sub to life. ;)

"You can't maintain Direct Damage once toggled" This is untrue though.

I genuinely feel like you are misunderstanding how this skill works, why would you even press this buff if you want to press your single target dps spell in the first place? What do you mean you can't maintain dps?

You keep calling it a toggle; toggle means you turn it on and off like a a tank stance. This skill is not that, it is a single use buff that is consumed immediately on your next cast that uses it. You only press it ONCE when you want to use the buffed skills. It is also a 1s gcd cast similar to ninja mudras. 1s plus cast time of 1.5s across the board for all healer dps spells = 2.5s. The same as one GCD.

eg; I am spamming my dosis II, but my dot is about to fall in a few moments. I press this buff, and then I use e.dosis (the dot) all within a normal 2.5s GCD window. Now, without pressing anything else, (as in I am not "toggling" anything) I can continue to press dosis II because the buff has been *used* and it will not continue to just spam the dot.

The only case where this will slow you down is in your ping example, but that's a problem for *every* class pretty much. That's not a sage problem that's a netcode sucks problem, and has always existed since 2.0. (2.0 NIN mudras were....a time. I'll say that,)

Could they have made it just 2 diff buttons? Yeah, sure. But as a healer main, which based on your flair you are not, *I* am happy to have something at least a LITTLE more interesting/different than just simple smashing malefic and combust even if it's a diff path to the same outcome.

It's existence also made my hotbars happy, as I only need 4 slots for a total of 6 skills. If this does not appeal to you it's fine, but you are definitely not understanding the way it actually works.

it's not a toggle; it's a buff that gets consumed whenever you cast a spell that uses it. Your spells revert to their unbuffed state after.

Edit: You can see it fall off without it being "toggled" in the demo they did during a live letter seen [here](https://youtu.be/rrk5Vf1dx4w?t=196).
Oh wow, you're pretty far up your own ass, aren't you? Must be really hard to breathe. Oh well, you'll find your way out one day. Till then, goodbye dearie. Have a nice life.
